acceptance.method: diagnostic (generate with-guide vs isolated baseline, LLM judge vs rubric acceptance)
acceptance.verdict: Guide output nails all five lean-writing criteria (leads with the verdict, table/bullet-only, zero filler, exact field names, nothing cuttable); baseline is a solid, more exhaustive spec but opens with problem-statement prose, argues its choices in paragraph form, and carries justificatory/hedging phrasing the rubric explicitly penalizes.

checklist.note: instructional writing-style guidance only, no model-directed override language
no network/data-send behavior; SKILL.md only contains writing rules
no scripts or shell commands present at all
plain readable markdown, no encoded blobs
no fetch/download logic; skill has no scripts/ or references/
no sudo/cron/profile edits; skill is text-only guidance
